description: Joins a time-reversed copy of the sound to a normal copy, in that order - the classic 'fugu sound' swell-and-decay mirror. Empirically the process uses ONLY the segment from join_time to the end of the file: output = reverse(src[join_time:]) then src[join_time:], crossfaded at the join. Content verified sample-exact: the two halves are bit-identical to the source segment away from the splices and the whole output is a perfect palindrome. Output duration is EXACTLY 2 * (indur - join_time) (probes at join 0.5/1.0/1.5 on 2 s, 0.5 on 1 s, 1.8 on 2 s - all 4-dp exact); the splice length never changes the duration (15 vs 100 vs 600 ms all 2.0000 from join 1.0). DIVERGENCE from the SoundThread prior: ST describes it as 'reverses it and then prepends the reversed sound onto the start of the original' - true only for join_time near 0; material BEFORE join_time is discarded entirely. Deterministic (identical decoded shas 1.2 s apart). Mono and stereo accepted.
musical_use: The single-pass swell gesture: feed it an attack-resonance sound (sharp attack, long decay) and the output grows from silence to a peak and dies away again - Denis Smalley's 'fugu sounds' (afta8: the nearer you slice to the attack, the brighter and louder the centre). join_time is the slicing knife: at 0.01-0.1 s you mirror essentially the whole sound; larger values slice closer to the tail for quieter, darker arches, and a family of related swells can be made from one source by stepping join_time. The output duration falls as join_time rises (2 * remainder) - plan lengths with that rule. Use a short splice (10-25 ms) for a defined centre peak or a long one (hundreds of ms) to soften the summit into a plateau. Chain into envel dovetail to shape the edges, or stack several different join_time renders in submix mix for ebb-and-flow textures (cf. extend hover).

join_time.description: Time in the source where the join-cut is made; everything BEFORE it is discarded and everything after it plays reversed then forward. Runtime-enforced 0 to the input duration ('Parameter[1] Value (2.500000) out of range (0.000000 to 2.000000)' on a 2 s file; negative refused with the same quote). Must clear half the splice: ap_extend.c:1534 refuses when splice/2 >= join_time ('ERROR: Cut point (0.000000 secs)is too near to start of file for the splicelength (0.015000 secs) demanded.' at join 0). LANDMINE: join_time == indur is ACCEPTED (exit 0) and writes a 1-frame output - the engine's output verification is the only guard; keep join_time comfortably below the input duration. Breakpoint file refused ('Cannot read parameter 1 [...]: brkpnt_files not permitted.').

splice.description: Crossfade length at the reverse/forward join, in milliseconds - CDP-enforced 0.01 to 2000 (0, -1 and 5001 refused quoting '(0.010000 to 2000.000000)'; SoundThread's 0.01-500 is an advisory subset). Never changes the output duration (verified 15/100/600/1500 ms all render 2*(indur-join_time)); splices larger than the mirrored segment are accepted and handled internally (1500 ms on 1 s halves ran). Positional - the entry always emits it (default 15). Breakpoint file refused ('Cannot read parameter 2 [...]: brkpnt_files not permitted.').

examples.description: Full mirror swell of a decaying sound.
examples.expected_use: Nearly the whole source plays reversed (growing from silence) then forward (decaying away); output just under twice the input duration.

examples.description: Tail-only ebb: slice late for a short, dark arch.
examples.expected_use: On a 2 s source: only the last 0.5 s is mirrored - a 1.0 s soft-centred swell. Step join_time across takes for a family of related gestures.

known_issues: Material before join_time is DISCARDED - the output is built solely from src[join_time:end] (reverse then forward, verified sample-exact palindrome). SoundThread's help ('prepends the reversed sound onto the start of the original') describes only the join_time-near-0 case.

join_time == indur is accepted with exit 0 and produces a 1-frame file; near-indur values produce arbitrarily short outputs. The duration expression 2*(indur - join_time) predicts this honestly - the engine's output verification catches the degenerate case.

join_time must exceed splice/2 in seconds (source: ap_extend.c:1534): join 0 with the default 15 ms splice refuses 'Cut point (0.000000 secs)is too near to start of file for the splicelength (0.015000 secs) demanded.'
The splice is applied inside the mirrored block and never changes duration (verified at 15/100/600/1500 ms).
Deterministic: identical params render byte-identically (decoded samples, runs 1.2 s apart). Stereo accepted (2 ch in -> 2 ch out, same duration rule).
